title: Inter at Feyenoord without Bastoni — three points from three
caption:
Inter go to Feyenoord tonight without Alessandro Bastoni, suspended, and both sides have three points from three in the Champions League, per Inter.it. Corriere dello Sport says the three Premier League signings have given Cristian Chivu almost nothing. Kickoff 3:00 PM ET / 21:00 CET.
